    • setTabCompleter

      public void setTabCompleter(TabCompleter completer)
      Sets the TabCompleter to run when tab-completing this command. 设置在此命令进行 Tab 补全时要运行的 TabCompleter。

      If no TabCompleter is specified, and the command's executor implements TabCompleter, then the executor will be used for tab completion. 若未指定 TabCompleter，且该命令的执行器实现了 TabCompleter，则该执行器将被用于 Tab 补全。

      参数:
      completer - New tab completer 新的 Tab 补全器

    • tabComplete

      public List<String> tabComplete(CommandSender sender, String alias, String[] args) throws CommandException, IllegalArgumentException
      Executed on tab completion for this command, returning a list of options the player can tab through. 在此命令进行 Tab 补全时执行，返回玩家可以 Tab 浏览的选项列表。

      Delegates to the tab completer if present. 若存在 Tab 补全器则委托给它。

      If it is not present or returns null, will delegate to the current command executor if it implements TabCompleter. If a non-null list has not been found, will default to standard player name completion in Command.tabComplete(CommandSender, String, String[]). 若它不存在或返回 null，则在当前命令执行器实现 TabCompleter 的情况下委托给该执行器。若仍未找到非 null 列表，将默认使用 Command.tabComplete(CommandSender, String, String[]) 中的标准玩家名称补全。

      This method does not consider permissions. 此方法不考虑权限。

      覆盖:
      tabComplete 在类中 Command
      参数:
      sender - Source object which is executing this command 正在执行此命令的来源对象
      alias - the alias being used 正在使用的别名
      args - All arguments passed to the command, split via ' ' 传递给该命令的所有参数，以 ' ' 分割
      返回:
      a list of tab-completions for the specified arguments. This 指定参数的 Tab 补全列表。这永远不会为 null。列表可能是不可变的。 will never be null. List may be immutable.
      抛出:
      CommandException - if the completer or executor throw an 若补全器或执行器在 Tab 补全过程中抛出异常。 exception during the process of tab-completing.
      IllegalArgumentException - if sender, alias, or args is null 若 sender、alias 或 args 为 null
